## infographic_data_chart_explainer

> Single-chart explainer panel — large hero chart annotated with three pull-out callouts and a source line.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/infographic_data/_vars_examples/infographic_data_chart_explainer.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical single-chart explainer titled "Quarterly throughput by region". The plate is a single hero chart (line, bar, or area) occupying the upper composition, annotated with three pull-out callouts that mark notable inflection points. A source line anchors the foot. The chart is the artifact; this is dataviz explanation, not a UI screen and not an artifact-shaped business card.
[2. Action] The reader anchors on the title, scans the chart shape, then reads the three callouts in order. The callouts are tied to actual chart positions by quiet leader lines, not floating decorations. A tiny source attribution (Source: ACME Data Lab, fictional dataset, 2026) closes the read at the foot of the plate.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat editorial plate. The background is an off-white paper field with a faint grid wash; no 3D space, no app chrome, no photographic backdrop.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 plate, 5% safe margins. Top ~12% carries the chart title. The hero chart occupies the central ~58% with full axis labels, gridlines, and ticks. Three callout boxes are arranged along the right edge, each connected to a chart position by a short leader rule. Bottom ~10% holds the source line. Generous leading; no overlapping callouts.
[5. Style] Editorial dataviz register with FT-style discipline. Two-color accent system on a neutral ground; type is one humanist sans used at clear hierarchy levels. Charts read like a newspaper figure — no 3D extrusion, no glow, no rainbow ramps, no photographic stock. Typesetting accuracy beats decoration.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- chart_title: "Quarterly throughput by region"
- callout1: "Q2 spike: pilot program goes live"
- callout2: "Q3 dip: seasonal port closure window"
- callout3: "Q1 FY26 rebound: new automation tier"

NO: 3D extruded charts, rainbow ramps, app-frame chrome, browser window mockups, glossy plastic gradients, photographic stock, drop shadows, lens flare, watermarks, clip-art icons, real news-brand logos, real public-figure portraits
```

## infographic_data_dashboard

> Editorial dataviz dashboard explainer with four chart panels, headline, and insight callouts.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/infographic_data/_vars_examples/infographic_data_dashboard.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A wide editorial dataviz dashboard explainer covering "Logistics throughput recovery, 2024-2026" over the period FY24 - Q1 FY26. The composition is a single composed plate of four chart panels (a bar, a line, a small-multiples grid, and a donut) plus a headline band and an insight pull-quote. This is an information-design output — readers come for the insight, not for clickable interaction.
[2. Action] The viewer reads the headline, scans the two KPI tiles to anchor scale, then walks left-to-right across the chart row, finishing on the highlighted insight callout. Every label and tick is set for legibility at briefing-room projector distance.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat editorial infographic plate. The background is a calm off-white field with a faint grid wash. No 3D rooms, no laptops, no app-frame chrome — this is a printed-style explainer, not a UI screenshot.
[4. Composition] Wide 16:9 plate, 4% safe margins. Top ~14% holds the headline band and the period label; below it, two KPI tiles sit on the left edge stacked vertically (~22% width). The remaining right region is divided into a 2-column x 2-row chart grid. A single insight callout rule connects one chart panel to a pull-quote band along the bottom 12%. Generous internal padding; no overlapping panels.
[5. Style] Editorial dataviz register in the lineage of FT Visual & Data, Reuters Graphics, Pew Research, and Information is Beautiful. Restrained palette of one neutral plus two accent hues; charts are typeset cleanly with axis labels, tick marks, and source line. Type system: humanist sans for body, slightly heavier cut for headline. No 3D extrusions, no glow, no photographic stock, no UI-app chrome.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- headline: "Logistics throughput recovery, 2024-2026"
- kpi1_label: "+18.4% units shipped"
- kpi2_label: "-9.2% on-time delay"
- insight_caption: "Coastal hubs led the rebound; inland nodes lag by two quarters"

NO: 3D extruded charts, rainbow palettes, app-frame chrome, browser window mockups, glossy plastic gradients, photographic stock, drop shadows, lens flare, watermarks, clip-art icons, real news-brand logos, real public-figure portraits
```
